title.value: IACA Regional Summer Academy - Central and South America 2027
title.evidence_quote: IACA Regional Summer Academy - Central and South America 2027 will be delivered in person in Panama City, Panama.

qualifications: Passport from one of the eligible countries: Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Guyana, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay or Venezuela
Experienced professionals are preferred; applicants with junior experience may be admitted subject to available seats
description_short: The International Anti-Corruption Academy's Regional Summer Academy for Central and South America is an in-person programme in Panama City, 19-23 April 2027, for anti-corruption and compliance professionals holding passports from eligible countries in the region.
